```{r}
#| include: true
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Annual probability of exceedance curves for maximum horizontal pseudo-spectral acceleration Sa(Tn) [g] with 5%% critical damping, evaluated for structural periods from %g to %g s and reference site conditions Vs30 = %s m/s."
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")

if (!exists("Vs30.target") || !length(Vs30.target)) {
  Vs30.target <- .resolveValueTarget(Vref.gmdp, "Vs30.target", "AEP.qmd")
}
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  AEPTable,
  "AEP.qmd",
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target"),
  base = TRUE
)
if (!exists("p.target") || !length(p.target)) p.target <- "mean"
if (!exists("Vref.target") || !length(Vref.target)) {
  Vref.target <- .resolveValueTarget(Vref.gmdp, "Vref.target", "AEP.qmd")
}
if (!exists("Tn.target") || !length(Tn.target)) Tn.target <- Tn.gmdp
Sa.log <- TRUE
AEP.log <- TRUE
```
